message:
The yen receipt test now passes, and the full suite is green (18 of 18).

The bug was in `src/utils/money.js`. `formatMoney` divided every amount by 100, so a receipt for ¥500 printed as "¥5.00". I added a set of zero-decimal currencies (currently just JPY). For those, the amount is printed as whole units with no decimals. Other currencies are unchanged.

Because invoices and cart totals use the same function, they also now show yen correctly. I did not commit the change.
